changelog:
Initial release providing comprehensive Amazon FBA operations tools for private label and wholesale sellers:

- Automated inventory health checks and reorder point alerts
- Listing audits with optimization recommendations and competitor comparison
- PPC campaign tracking, ACoS monitoring, and budget pacing features
- Daily review monitoring, response templates, and review velocity tracking
- Financial templates for P&L, unit economics, and Q4 planning
- Competitor price monitoring, Buy Box tracking, and new entrant alerts
- Setup guidance for key business inputs (ASINs, targets, suppliers)
summary: Amazon FBA seller operations for private label and wholesale sellers. Inventory alerts, reorder point calculations, listing optimization, PPC budget tracking...
